name: Source Products Flow

sequentialJustification.detail: Every linked guest is wasi-sequential; the flow dispatches them serially and delegates external concurrency to its host.

description: Catalog pipeline C2: the products of one source, generic over the source's type, as one pure-compute flow. An element-set source (ingress element_sets, or element_sets_mpe for the archive's $MPE records, and models) gets its newest sets' epoch states (epoch-state derive_omm), the covariance of each object by rule (gp-error-model attach_covariance) written into $OCM and $OMM with its CVR (COV_REALISM) and the source in PROVENANCE, and its history screened for maneuvers in the detector's two passes with SGP4 answering the propagator query port (epoch-state answer_propagation_requests), attributed to the source in the $MNV PROVENANCE. An ephemeris source (fit_omm, ephemeris, ephemeris_versions, planned_maneuvers) brings the SGP4 element sets analysis/od fitted to its ephemeris; the newest set gets the same states and covariance, the operator's covariance lines are rule 1, the versions are checked against the planned maneuvers (maneuver-detection compare_ephemerides), and the history of fitted sets is screened for maneuvers in the same two passes. An observation source (fit_omm, fit) brings the element set fitted to its estimated arc and the estimate's state and formal covariance, scaled by the measured realism factor (rule 2). Every ingress frame is enqueued before the flow drains. A node whose inputs come from an upstream node declares them required, so it never runs on a part of its inputs. The source's recipe is the flow's node configuration (plugin.getConfig, one ModuleConfig for every node): derive.ages for epoch-state, attach.* for attach_covariance, attribute.* for attribute_maneuvers, maneuver-detection's options at the root; one run is one source. The reports are typed: FlowNotice (derive, mpe), $PRW WINDOW_REPORT (propagation), $MDE (detect, compare), $ERM ATTACH_REPORT (covariance, attribute).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $OMM element sets, concatenated; zero-length prefixes are padding. MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY must be SGP4; EPOCH is ISO 8601 UTC. The object is NORAD_CAT_ID, else OBJECT_ID, else OBJECT_NAME.

inputPorts.description: Size-prefixed $OMM element sets, concatenated; zero-length prefixes are padding. MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY must be SGP4; EPOCH is ISO 8601 UTC. The object is NORAD_CAT_ID, else OBJECT_ID, else OBJECT_NAME.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The element sets of one source, SGP4 (an SGP4-XP set is passed through without a covariance until the XP propagator and error model land). Only the newest set of each object gives outputs unless the recipe says latestOnly false.

inputPorts.description: The element sets of one source, SGP4 (an SGP4-XP set is passed through without a covariance until the XP propagator and error model land). Only the newest set of each object gives outputs unless the recipe says latestOnly false.

Element sets ($OMM, plain or a stream of size-prefixed records): the module asks for their trajectories on propagation_requests and reads the answers on propagation. Grouped by NORAD_CAT_ID (else OBJECT_ID, else OBJECT_NAME); one set per EPOCH (a later record replaces an earlier one).

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) Info: SCHEMA $OMM, SOURCE_NAME "epoch-state omm_from_mpe", COUNT the records converted, REASON converted or refused-element-sets; ITEMS records=, converted=, failed=, then one "failure index=<i> entity_id=<id> reason=<r>" per refused record.

outputPorts.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) Info: SCHEMA $OMM, SOURCE_NAME "epoch-state omm_from_mpe", COUNT the records converted, REASON converted or refused-element-sets; ITEMS records=, converted=, failed=, then one "failure index=<i> entity_id=<id> reason=<r>" per refused record.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One $OCM per object: the product's states (GCRF, km, km/s) and the covariance of each (21-element lower triangle, km**2 family, RTN axes for a modeled covariance, as supplied for an operator's) with a CVR per covariance epoch in COV_REALISM, COV_CALIBRATION (Calibrated only when every CVR is) and its evidence, and the source in PROVENANCE.

outputPorts.description: One $OCM per object: the product's states (GCRF, km, km/s) and the covariance of each (21-element lower triangle, km**2 family, RTN axes for a modeled covariance, as supplied for an operator's) with a CVR per covariance epoch in COV_REALISM, COV_CALIBRATION (Calibrated only when every CVR is) and its evidence, and the source in PROVENANCE.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The element sets as published, ORIGINATOR the producer (the message's creator), PROVENANCE naming the source, COVARIANCE (RTN lower triangle) of the row nearest the epoch with COV_REFERENCE_FRAME RSW, and that row's CVR in COV_REALISM.

outputPorts.description: The element sets as published, ORIGINATOR the producer (the message's creator), PROVENANCE naming the source, COVARIANCE (RTN lower triangle) of the row nearest the epoch with COV_REFERENCE_FRAME RSW, and that row's CVR in COV_REALISM.

One $ERM ATTACH_REPORT record: the source (PVN), per object the rule that applied, why the earlier rules did not, every row's CVR label and verdict, the SHA-256 of each record; refused and unmatched records.

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) Info: SCHEMA $OEM, SOURCE_NAME "epoch-state derive", COUNT the element sets derived, REASON derived or refused-element-sets; ITEMS records=, derived=, failed=, rows=, ages_days=, epochs_outside_leap_second_table=, max_round_trip_position_km=, max_round_trip_velocity_km_s= (%.17g), then one "failure index=<i> entity_id=<id> reason=<r> sgp4_error=<n>" per refused element set.

outputPorts.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) Info: SCHEMA $OEM, SOURCE_NAME "epoch-state derive", COUNT the element sets derived, REASON derived or refused-element-sets; ITEMS records=, derived=, failed=, rows=, ages_days=, epochs_outside_leap_second_table=, max_round_trip_position_km=, max_round_trip_velocity_km_s= (%.17g), then one "failure index=<i> entity_id=<id> reason=<r> sgp4_error=<n>" per refused element set.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The same maneuvers with PROVENANCE naming the source (SOURCE_ID, SOURCE_KIND, ORIGINATOR, PROVIDER_ID, LICENSE_CLASS, LICENSE_ID, LINEAGE) and the software that made the maneuver (PRODUCER).

outputPorts.description: The same maneuvers with PROVENANCE naming the source (SOURCE_ID, SOURCE_KIND, ORIGINATOR, PROVIDER_ID, LICENSE_CLASS, LICENSE_ID, LINEAGE) and the software that made the maneuver (PRODUCER).
One $ERM ATTACH_REPORT record: the source and producer (SOURCE) and the maneuvers attributed (COUNTS.MANEUVERS).

One $MDE with the DETECT_REPORT arm: run status (NeedsPropagation with the query count, or Detected), duplicate epochs and refused sets, the options used, and per object its crossing pairs, levels (report_levels), every event each detector raised with its evidence, and the emitted events (MNV_ID names each $MNV).

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $PRW whose WINDOW_REPORT arm counts the queries, answered and refused, the element-set records received, the refusals (SEQUENCE, SET_INDEX, REASON) and the provider (SGP4, Vallado, WGS-72, opsmode i; TEME, UTC, km and km/s).

outputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $PRW whose WINDOW_REPORT arm counts the queries, answered and refused, the element-set records received, the refusals (SEQUENCE, SET_INDEX, REASON) and the provider (SGP4, Vallado, WGS-72, opsmode i; TEME, UTC, km and km/s).

One $MDE with the COMPARE_REPORT arm: per object the version changes (mode, window, delta SMA, in-track and cross-track delta-V) and each planned maneuver check (pre and post versions, modelled and executed change, status), with the counts.
